message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: On Dec 22, 2014, Liu, due to economic dispute, went to victim's house (Lu) with a pry bar (撅头) and ladder, smashed the security door, and smashed inside items: two TVs, a refrigerator, a water dispenser, a set of table and chairs, a tea table, etc. Damage value 8817 yuan. After, parties reached compensation agreement.

This is intentional destruction of property. The appropriate charge is 故意毁坏财物 (intentional damage to property). No theft, no robbery, no assault. So single charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意毁坏财物<eoa>
